purpose: Define Retry semantics for Secret Lease and Resolution

retryContract.sameInvocation: Same Invocation Lease is reusable within TTL/new resolve if expired
retryContract.newAttempt: Retry within same Invocation reuses Lease if CanUse=true
retryContract.newInvocation: New Invocation requires new Lease (new RuntimeInstance context)
retryContract.maxRetryBudget: Retry does NOT extend Lease TTL — TTL is absolute from Issue time
retryContract.circuitBreaker: Secret Resolution failure does NOT trigger Provider Circuit Breaker

note: Current TrustedService SecretLease does not track Invocation ID directly — RuntimeInstance binding may be insufficient for fine-grained Invocation-level lease isolation
